_why: This fixture carries block/content{}/trace{} on every card BECAUSE that is what
a real episode.json must now carry. If the mock scaffolded the old shape, a
--mock run would prove the render side works while hiding the fact that a real
episode would arrive without the fields the authoring needs. The mock has to
fail the same way the real thing would.
C3 is deliberately block:bespoke so every run proves a hand-authored card is
